definition: For each executed CORRECT_CODE, RE_PORTION, RE_DECOMPOSE, or RETRIEVE step, compare nutri_dish on that row with nutri_dish on the next logged row. Changed means energy_kcal and/or mass_g moved by more than epsilon, including a finite value appearing or disappearing. Both sides missing is no change. A tool that is the last row has no post-state and is no_successor, not a change. Epsilon is half the 1e-4 nutrient rounding quantum. FixRate's 1 kcal threshold is not used. Cafe labels and rgb_test nutrition are not read.
scope: P0a audit gate only. Mass Estimator was not trained. No new weights. No RL.

epsilon.label: 5e-5
epsilon.rule: strictly greater than epsilon. A difference equal to epsilon is not a change.
epsilon.source: Half of the teacher _round_nutri quantum (4 decimal places, 1e-4). Not fit on hold-out or rgb_test.

comparison: pre = nutri_dish on the tool row (state before action_t). post = nutri_dish on the next logged row (state after the tool, before the next action).
change_rule: changed if |Δenergy| > ε or |Δmass| > ε, or exactly one side of a field is finite. Both sides missing is unchanged. no_successor is a separate outcome and is not a change.

CORRECT_CODE.mass_note: mass_g stayed within ε on every executed step; energy_kcal moved on the changed steps. A same-gram code swap does not move mass.
